title: Maria Wang says her husband reported directly to Henry Kissinger
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Maria Wang says her husband reported directly to Henry Kissinger, about 1950s-1960 at Wright-Patterson AFB, Ohio, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: She said that her husband had reported directly to Henry Kissinger.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a woman named Maria Wang, whose husband Eric Wang is said to have worked in the 1950s at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio, a base long linked in UFO stories to recovered crashed craft. Michels says she stated that her husband reported directly to the American statesman Henry Kissinger, with the story also traced through a researcher named William Steinman. If true, it would place Kissinger over a programme for recovering crashed UFOs.
